facts.fact: Wingu Africa stated in its June 2025 funding announcement that it has a Tier-III certified campus in Ethiopia hosting the ADDIX exchange; the document gives no certifying body or certification date, so as_of is the article date.

Wingu Africa, a data centre operator serving over 40 customers including telecoms, hyperscalers and financial institutions across its region, states it operates a campus in Ethiopia hosting the ADDIX exchange; as_of is the article date.
